panels.title: Model usage cost
panels.description: Usage analytics from ClickHouse request_logs grouped by model.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model, count() AS request_count, sum(request_tokens + response_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM request_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY model ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Feature usage
panels.description: Usage analytics from ClickHouse request_logs grouped by relay feature.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(JSONExtractString(metadata, 'relay_api_type'), ''), service, 'unknown') AS feature, count() AS request_count, sum(request_tokens + response_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM request_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY feature ORDER BY total_tokens DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top user cost
panels.description: Usage analytics from ClickHouse request_logs grouped by original user identity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(JSONExtractString(metadata, 'user_id'), ''), toString(user_id)) AS user_id, count() AS request_count, sum(request_tokens + response_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM request_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Usage time trend
panels.description: Usage analytics request, token, and cost trend from ClickHouse request_logs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, count() AS request_count, sum(request_tokens + response_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM request_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Model x time
panels.description: Cross-dimension usage analytics for model x time cost trends.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, model, count() AS request_count, sum(request_tokens + response_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM request_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time ASC, total_cost DESC

panels.title: User x feature
panels.description: Cross-dimension usage analytics for user x feature preferences and cost.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(JSONExtractString(metadata, 'user_id'), ''), toString(user_id)) AS user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSONExtractString(metadata, 'relay_api_type'), ''), service, 'unknown') AS feature, count() AS request_count, sum(request_tokens + response_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM request_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY user_id, feature ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Feature x time
panels.description: Cross-dimension usage analytics for feature x time trends.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, COALESCE(NULLIF(JSONExtractString(metadata, 'relay_api_type'), ''), service, 'unknown') AS feature, count() AS request_count, sum(request_tokens + response_tokens) AS total_tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM request_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time, feature ORDER BY time ASC, total_cost DESC
